title: Fixed-degree localized tensor cohomology comparison inheritance
statement: Let R,A,B,C be commutative rings in a universe u, A and B commutative R-algebras, and C an algebra over E=A tensor_R B. Use the derived categories of R-, A- and B-modules. Let Q be a cochain complex of A-modules, N a cochain complex of C-modules, F termwise scalar extension along A to E to C, and t:F(Q) to N a chain map. Assume C is flat over E and U,Q are K-flat complexes of A-modules. Let m,mU be the base-derived tensor cohomology models for Q and U tensor_A Q. Suppose m.localizedComparison_j followed by H^j(t) is invertible for EVERY integer j. For a fixed integer i, mU.localizedComparison_i followed by H^i(mu_F(U,Q)^(-1) followed by (F(U) tensor t)) is invertible. The hypothesis ranges over all degrees because shifts of U can bring another degree into degree i.

proof.text: Define the explicit property P on D(A) by universal quantification over its K-flat representatives and cohomology models.
Apply the generator assertion and the coproduct, triangle and retract closure assertion to P.
Apply derivedModuleFreeGeneration to Q_A(U); then specialize P to U, the identity isomorphism, hU, mU and i.

theorem localizedTensorComparison_inheritance_fixed_degree
    (R A B C : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] [Algebra (A ⊗[R] B) C]
    (hC : Module.Flat (A ⊗[R] B) C)
    (U Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (N : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} C) ℤ)
    (hU : ∀ V : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ, V.Acyclic →
      (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor V U (curriedTensor _)).Acyclic)
    (hQ : ∀ V : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ, V.Acyclic →
      (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor V Q (curriedTensor _)).Acyclic) :
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} R)
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} B)
    let F := (extendScalars.{u, u, u}
      ((algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) C).comp (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)))).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)
    ∀ (t : F.obj Q ⟶ N)
      (m : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q C)
      (mU : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B (U ⊗ Q) C)
      (i : ℤ),
      (∀ j : ℤ, IsIso (m.localizedComparison j ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap t j)) →
      IsIso (mU.localizedComparison i ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
        ((Functor.Monoidal.μIso F U Q).inv ≫ (F.obj U ◁ t)) i)

statement_change.old_statement: Under the hypotheses of localized tensor comparison inheritance, for a fixed cohomological degree i, if the localized comparison for Q followed by H^i(t) is an isomorphism, then the corresponding map for U tensor Q is an isomorphism.
statement_change.what: The former single-degree assertion is false: take R=A=B=C=Z, Q=0, N=Z in degree 1, U=Z in degree -1 and i=0. Both U and Q are K-flat and C is E-flat. The degree-zero premise is the isomorphism 0 to 0, while the conclusion is 0 to Z. Require the premise for all degrees, as the actual source and the global caller already do. This is a correction of an intermediate helper, not a change of any Challenge target.

old_proof.text: For fixed degree i, perform the mixed-ring K-flat associator calculation and identify the model counit comparison after flat scalar extension.
The comparisons that are isomorphisms form a localizing subcategory in U; shifts, sums, triangles and retracts preserve the property, and free generation by shifts of A gives the claim for U.
